name: 拉特
evolution: 拉特 → 酷拉 Lv.40 → 风暴酷拉
description: 同伴之间经常会打架，用头或者用拳头对撞，每撞一下都会闪着电光。大多数拉特沉默寡言，但正义感十足，拉特们会出手帮助遇到麻烦的洛克和精灵。
descriptionEn: Companions often fight each other, butting heads or fists, each collision flashing with electric light. Most Late are silent and reserved, but full of justice; they will step in to help Lockes and sprites in trouble.

skills.name: 球状闪电
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy sprite.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%, in response to attacks.

skills.name: 超导加速
skills.description: 造成魔伤，自己获得速度+30。

skills.name: 过载回路
skills.description: 回合结束自己返场，下回合所选技能使用次数+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Returns at end of turn; next turn's selected skill gains +1 use.

skills.name: 超导
skills.description: 造成魔伤，迸发：本技能能耗-1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; Burst: this skill's energy cost -1.

skills.name: 电弧
skills.description: 造成物伤，迸发：本次技能威力+40。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; Burst: this skill's power +40.

skills.name: 麻痹
skills.description: 敌方先手-1，应对防御：额外使敌方获得双攻-70%。
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy's first-strike -1; against Defense: additionally enemy gains both ATK -70%.

skills.name: 飞踢
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy sprite.

skills.name: 闪击折返
skills.description: 造成物伤，2连击，自己脱离。

skills.name: 雷暴
skills.description: 造成魔伤，迸发：本技能获得所有生效过的迸发，每获得1种，本技能能耗+1，威力+10。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; Burst: gains all previously triggered bursts; each one adds energy cost +1 and power +10.

skills.name: 阻断
skills.description: 造成魔伤，应对状态：额外打断被应对技能。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; against status: additionally interrupts the responded skill.

skills.name: 强制重启
skills.description: 造成魔伤，应对状态：回合结束时使敌方精灵返场。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; against status: at end of turn forces the enemy sprite to return.
